source.title: ALM COVID19 & TC Protest Response Food Program Sign Up

questions.label: Email
questions.note: The form's own email box (Google's collect-email setting), shown above the questions.

questions.label: Zip Code
questions.note: Pick the ZIP from three North Minneapolis codes; no answer rule matches the saved ZIP to choices.

questions.label: I am filling this form out for?
options: I am filling this form out for Me and My Household
I am filling this form out for a Senior NOT In my household
questions.note: Who the form is for; not in the profile.

questions.label: Authorized Agent Full Name (First & Last)
questions.note: Only shown when filling in for a senior outside the household; the agent is not the household the profile describes.

questions.label: Authorized Agent Phone Number
questions.note: Only shown when filling in for a senior outside the household; the agent's phone, not the household's.

questions.label: Full Street Address w/Apt #
questions.note: One box for the street address, with any apartment number added; the street address is the saved field it holds.

questions.label: City
questions.note: A lone checkbox confirming the city; no answer rule checks the saved city.

questions.label: State
questions.note: A lone checkbox; ticking "MN" says the household lives in Minnesota.

questions.label: How many people in your household
questions.note: The form validates a number from 0 to 10.

questions.label: How Many Children in household between Ages 0 - 18
questions.note: Ages 0-18 counts 18-year-olds, whom the profile counts as adults; the profile's children are 0-17.

questions.label: How Many Adults in household between Ages 19 - 64
questions.note: Ages 19-64 leaves out 18-year-olds; the profile counts adults 18-64.

questions.label: How Many Seniors in household Ages 65+
questions.note: Help text: if no seniors in the household put 0.

questions.label: Accurate Information Agreement: By entering your initials in the box below, you are in effect providing your signature, indicating that all the information on this form is true and accurate, to the best of your knowledge.
Enter your initials in the box below

Agreement/Disclaimer: By entering your FULL NAME in the box below, you are effect providing your signature as consent, indicating that You give permission to Al-Maa'uun's staff and volunteers to deliver meals for the number of children and/or seniors indicated in this registration.
questions.note: A full name typed as a signature. Label cut to the 300-character limit; the page continues: "A food shelf Box will be delivered to the specific address you have listed above for your household."

questions.label: Do you have any of these devices in your household?
options: Laptop or Desktop Computer with Audio/Video Capabilities
No I have no Technology listed above in my home
questions.note: Technology survey; not in the profile.

questions.label: In order to better serve you please answer a few questions: *What are other needs you may have during this Pandemic? *Do You or any one in your household have a physical disability? If so please list the age of the person/people.
questions.note: Open description of needs and the ages of anyone with a physical disability; the profile has no text for this.
